entries.what: Linh woke at 6:45 and went to Anatomy at Tamsen Valley, then sat in the library with her planner. She asked the assistant for a 7 a.m. registration checklist with backup nutrition sections ranked.
entries.outcome: Got a short timed checklist with ranked backups and taped it into her planner.

entries.what: Worked the Monday 3-9 closing shift at Heron & Grind with Jun, logged milk waste and locked the vault-room outlets.
entries.outcome: Closed clean; Jun teased her about the registration plan.

entries.what: Got home late and ate the plate Hạnh left. Charged her laptop and reread the checklist before bed.
entries.outcome: Asleep by 12:30.

entries.what: Alarmed at 6:58 with three alarms set, Linh sat at the laptop with the sticky e key and logged in at 7 a.m. for priority registration. She grabbed the nutrition section and a backup chem lab seat.
entries.outcome: Got into the Intro to Nutrition section she wanted.

entries.what: Went to General Chemistry at 11 a.m. Kenji gave her a ride in his hatchback and she told him quietly about the section.
entries.outcome: Kenji promised not to gossip.

entries.what: Attended Pedro's 4 p.m. anatomy study group at the library with Pedro's bone models.
entries.outcome: Reviewed the digestive system and left with a quiz sheet.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. Over a packed rice bowl lunch she looked at Hạnh's late-plate habit and sketched a week of balanced family dinners in her planner, with veggies and protein.
entries.outcome: Asked the assistant to turn the sketch into a shopping list and times.

entries.what: Worked the Wednesday 3-9 closing shift at Heron & Grind. Wes called her Doc when she made his cortado.
entries.outcome: Uneventful close; she reviewed flashcards on break.

entries.what: Biked home on the e-bike she charged behind the counter and left a note for Hạnh about Thursday's dinner.
entries.outcome: Note left on the fridge.

entries.what: Kenji drove her to General Chemistry at 11 a.m. She studied problem sets in the library after.
entries.outcome: Finished the problem set early.

entries.what: Cooked the first planned dinner at home with groceries from Ruiz Family Market. Hạnh got home from Lotus Nails and tasted it, saying it needed salt.
entries.outcome: Hạnh ate two bowls and said nothing more.

entries.what: Called Thao before her night shift to say goodnight and ask about phở on the weekend.
entries.outcome: Thao agreed to phở Saturday morning.

entries.what: Attended Anatomy at 9 a.m. and reviewed the week with her color-coded notes at the library.
entries.outcome: Notes caught up through the digestion unit.

entries.what: Lunch with Kenji at Heron & Grind's vault-wall outlets, where he studied for his transfer app.
entries.outcome: Kenji's Nov 30 deadline was on his mind.

entries.what: Sunday-style planning on a Friday evening: wrote next week's schedule in her planner with washi tape and packed a rice bowl for Saturday.
entries.outcome: Planner set for Saturday's shift and the food drive.

entries.what: Worked 6:30-1 at Heron & Grind, busy with weekend regulars. Sam was meant to be there but traded again.
entries.outcome: Got through the rush without him.

entries.what: Afternoon at Our Lady of the Marsh for the Thanksgiving food drive, sorting groceries into family boxes with Father Ben's volunteers.
entries.outcome: Packed over forty boxes.

entries.what: Had phở with Thao after her night stretch at Phở Bến Thành.
entries.outcome: Thao slept at the table while Linh ate.

entries.what: Opened the Sunday shift at Heron & Grind at 6:30 and worked until 1.
entries.outcome: Quiet morning; Jun's lumpia spot is going well.

entries.what: Helped at the Lotus Nails front desk from 2 to 5, booking appointments for Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Hạnh brought up pharmacy once and Linh changed the subject.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk at dusk, then planned the week in her paper planner that night.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out with times.
